_comment: Caps equal the measured physical Rust product lines in crates/*/src. Test files and directories (tests/, test_support/, tests.rs, test_support.rs, workspace tests/, and scripts/test-support/) and inline test-only #[cfg(test)] and #[cfg(all(..., test, ...))] modules are uncapped; every other crate src line counts against its per-crate cap and totalMax. Any product-line change updates the affected caps in the same change; headroom is rejected.
